properties.value: Single source of truth for ignored advisories. deny.toml [advisories].ignore and src-tauri/.cargo/audit.toml must list exactly these ids (scripts/supply-chain/vex-check.sh). opensidian:expires = date after which the ignore is invalid and CI fails.

Bundled in ui/vendor/mermaid/mermaid.min.js (mermaid 11.17.2). DOMPurify is mermaid-internal (not exported, the app has no own DOMPurify call). All 7 .sanitize( call sites in the bundle pass a STRING and one of: no config, {FORBID_TAGS:["style"]}, {ADD_TAGS,ADD_ATTR,HTML_INTEGRATION_POINTS:{foreignobject}}, or config.dompurifyConfig; the result is used as a string (.toString()/d3 .html()). The app pins dompurifyConfig:{} (ui/plugins/api-functions.js:938) and lists dompurifyConfig + securityLevel in mermaid `secure` (:904), so %%{init}%% / frontmatter config from a note cannot set any DOMPurify option. Advisory needs IN_PLACE:true (sanitizing a live DOM node with a removing hook); IN_PLACE is never set (the token appears once in the bundle: DOMPurify's own option parser) and every input is a string. Fix: mermaid 12.3.0 (2026-11-03, dompurify ^3.4.17, katex ^0.18.0) passes the 6-week rule on 2026-12-15 -> vendor bump before expiry.

Bundled in ui/vendor/mermaid/mermaid.min.js (mermaid 11.17.2). Advisory needs YAML merge keys (<<, type tag:yaml.org,2002:merge), which js-yaml defines ONLY in DEFAULT_SCHEMA. All 4 js-yaml load() call sites in the bundle (frontmatter + node/edge metadata) pass {schema: JSON_SCHEMA} (failsafe + null/bool/int/float); DEFAULT_SCHEMA is imported but never used. Under JSON_SCHEMA `<<` resolves to a plain string key and an explicit !!merge is an unknown tag (error), so mergeMappings is never entered. Input is also capped by maxTextSize 50000 (api-functions.js:907). Fix: mermaid >= the 12.3.0 bump (see dompurify entries) or a release bundling js-yaml >= 4.3.2.

Bundled in ui/vendor/mermaid/mermaid.min.js (mermaid 11.17.2). Advisory needs the !!omap type (tag:yaml.org,2002:omap), defined ONLY in js-yaml DEFAULT_SCHEMA. All 4 load() call sites pass {schema: JSON_SCHEMA}; there `!!omap` is an unknown tag and throws before any omap resolution. DEFAULT_SCHEMA unused. Fix: vendor bump to a mermaid bundling js-yaml >= 4.3.1/4.3.2.
